summary: Digimarc Corp filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Sales Agreement with Needham & Company, LLC for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $17.5 million of its common stock. Shares will be sold under an existing shelf registration statement via ordinary brokers' transactions, block trades, or other agreed methods at market prices. The Sales Agent receives a 3.00% commission. This represents an equity capital raise using a standard ATM program, not a special situation. No forced management change occurred; the Item 5.02 disclosure only concerns an appointment, not an abrupt departure.
